pages.title: 菜谱首页 · 横向分类与单列卡片
interactionContract: Top category taps and horizontal list paging stay bidirectionally synchronized.
The category strip scrolls directly by horizontal swipe and has no trailing arrow control.
Search, filters, and section heading remain fixed while category pages move horizontally.
Each category keeps independent vertical offset, pull-to-refresh state, and incremental pagination.
Navigation edge-pop wins over horizontal category paging at the leading screen edge.
Filter changes reload only the visible page immediately and mark other initialized pages stale.
Vertical lists use pull-to-refresh and automatic upward pagination; no manual next-page button.

approvedUserChanges.change: Remove the right-side category arrow and give its width back to the horizontally scrollable category strip.

allowedDynamicChanges: recipe content, counts, loading, empty, and failure states
safe-area and Dynamic Type adaptation without changing information hierarchy

pages.title: 制定计划与多选菜谱
interactionContract: Navigation uses push/pop with guarded edge-back for local unsaved selection.
Selection and form edits only update local drafts. Save submits one atomic batch.
Single day or finite inclusive range supports selected ISO weekdays. No indefinite background generation.
Selecting recipes supports localized name/ingredient search, all/favorite/frequent sources, multiple selection, existing-meal indicators, native pull refresh and MJRefresh upward paging.
No inventory deduction when saving a plan. Existing recipes are skipped without altering their servings or cooking records.
allowedDynamicChanges: loading, empty, failed, existing and selected states
date picker and weekly repeat expanded states using native UIKit controls
implementationNotes: Dates and selected weekday expansion are capped at 42 inclusive days as an explicit bounded API rule; this is not an unlimited recurring schedule.
Hash/constant verification detects drift; it does not replace simulator visual and interaction review.

pages.title: 调整当餐计划

scrollingRegions: meal selection and actions when Dynamic Type needs more room

interactionContract: The contextual menu is a bottom sheet on the existing day plan; recipe and date editors push onto the existing navigation stack.
For meals with several dishes, select a dish before changing its plan. Completed dishes cannot be replaced or skipped.
Move drafts stay local until save; expectedRevision prevents overwriting concurrent changes. Lost-response recovery accepts only an exactly matching server state.
Skip is reversible and keeps the plan visible; remove keeps cooking history. Neither operation creates cooking history or deducts stock.
allowedDynamicChanges: native sheet detent adapts to screen size; iOS15 uses large detent for accessibility
implementationNotes: Actions use the system UISheetPresentationController. The 42 pt drawn rows gain a 44 pt minimum touch area.
This page edits the selected occurrence; linked recurring-series editing is not claimed implemented.

pages.title: 确认完成做菜
interactionContract: Push/pop navigation; actual quantities and material choices remain local until confirmation.
Date and meal use native controls; action sheets anchor to the tapped control.
Save uses one stable cooking-record UUID, expectedPlanRevision and actual materials. Record, inventory and receipt commit or roll back together.
Unknown transport results freeze the payload for exact retry; stock rejection permits edits. Plan conflicts first reconcile an existing cooking record; never silently create another record ID.

Missing cost is displayed as unavailable, never zero. Debounced server previews read the actual inventory price basis without saving the draft or reserving stock; confirmation revalidates. Material-delta editing is tracked by plan-record-edit-r1.
allowedDynamicChanges: Explicit missing price and missing translation states
implementationNotes: Approved source defines layout. Cost preview fills the existing cost cells and summary without rebuilding the focused material field.
Source/hash verification supplements simulator checks; it does not replace them.

layoutContract.confirmation: Centered white card over dimmed current detail, with keep and destructive confirm actions

interactionContract: Push/pop detail; editing expands in place and only changes a local account-scoped draft until save.
The original record revision and a single request UUID freeze together for uncertain retries; a conflict requires explicit reload.
Successful ordinary save uses the response snapshot and invalidates affected caches; uncertain retry success fetches latest once because a replay may be historical.
Changed quantities update only inventory deltas; undo sends the original expectedRevision and restores only net remaining consumption.
Unknown costs remain unavailable; changing quantities immediately clears any displayed stale total.
Historical ingredient names remain user record snapshots; interface actions and server units use the app language.
allowedDynamicChanges: material count, quantity, unit and known/missing costs
native date picker and unit/meal action sheets anchored to their source
implementationNotes: ACTUAL records use this page. NONE and LEGACY keep their existing editor; LEGACY quantities are read-only.
Cost basis and per-lot prices are not implemented; explicit unavailable state prevents stale/zero costs.
This baseline traces the approved design source; verification checks source hashes and constants, while simulator evidence separately checks behavior and visible layout.

pages.title: 计划做菜记录：月汇总与按日历史

fixed: centered navigation title, back, add-record action
scrolling: monthly completed count and cooking-day cards
month heading and seven-day date strip

interactionContract: This plan-tab entry uses design08. The previously confirmed profile calendar/list view remains separate.
Records use native reusable UITableView and stable diffable IDs. A full card opens the existing detail via push/pop.
GET month/date/page loads20 selected-day records; day totals and month summary come from full server aggregates, never from the visible page.
Native pull-to-refresh resets the selected day to page0. Existing MJRefresh handles automatic upward paging; failure does not advance its page.
Week navigation and day selection are local controls; recent day snapshots are reused. Child writes invalidate local snapshots and reload shown pages once on return.
Loading, failure, empty and missing-cost states remain distinct. Unknown cost is not rendered as zero, and currencies are not added together.
Backfill targets the selected date and existing multi-dish/multi-meal local draft; future dates cannot create history.
allowedDynamicChanges: record content, counts, missing costs, loading and error states
vertical list length and server pagination
implementationNotes: Monthly dish statistics reuse the existing statistics page with an explicit month scope; full design10 visual implementation remains separate.
Inventory-derived cost calculation is not claimed complete. Displayed costs are only existing record values with missing amounts explicitly identified.
Seven-day strip is centered on initial selection; arrows move7days. Tapping another day in the visible strip preserves its visible dates.

pages.title: 同日多菜多餐补记与实际库存确认

fixed: centered title, back and local draft action
scrolling: ingredient / actual amount / unit / stock cost table

interactionContract: One shared actual date, at most30 dishes; each dish has its own meal. User explicitly requested multiple dishes/meals on one date, not a range of dates.
Only the selected dish is expanded to preserve the existing design07 hierarchy. Native actions switch between already added dishes.
Drafts and typed material amounts are local, scoped by account and personal/household inventory. Reading units/catalog/balances never writes a cooking record.
Recipe quantities are cleared on selection; users confirm positive actual quantities and mapped inventory ingredients before saving.
One batch request commits all records and stock changes atomically. An uncertain result freezes request UUID, full payload and request language across relaunch and retry.
Known business validation/stock rejection allows editing; authentication, permission and unknown transport failures retain the receipt.

One debounced read-only server preview quotes the complete multi-dish draft together. Currencies remain separate; missing unit cost and total are explicit, never zero. Editing stays local and does not reserve inventory.
allowedDynamicChanges: user-authorized multiple dish and meal selection
implementationNotes: No new dependencies. Reuse UIKit controls, existing SnapKit constraints, catalog picker and local draft store.
Legacy personal drafts for the selected date are imported without deleting unrelated dates; legacy cleanup happens only after a valid atomic response.
Source and constant verification supplements, and does not replace, simulator layout and behavior checks.
V46 purchase/cost basis and read-only cooking-cost-previews supply this page. Unit price keeps up to six decimal places; save independently revalidates current stock and history.

pages.title: 食材首页、食材大全与组合推荐
interactionContract: Fixed search and category sidebar; card list alone uses pull refresh and MJRefresh pagination.
Combination mode, selected chips, taste and time remain above the results scroll. Edge navigation gesture has priority.
At home picks positive stock; free choice uses current-language published catalog. Up to 40 unique standard IDs, no selection writes.
Server returns AVAILABLE, SHORT or UNCONFIRMED, never assume uncertain conversion is sufficient stock.
Use persisted server iconKey, category fallback, then generic; no translated-name identity guessing.
Account, household and language switches cancel stale requests and clear old context.
implementationBoundary: Merchant receipt parsing has no external provider contract yet.
Hash checks are not a substitute for simulator and visual verification.

pages.title: 菜品使用统计与采购清单原子入库
interactionContract: 10 keeps week/month/custom filters, three summary values, ranked recipe cards and original orange/green palette. Infinite pagination uses existing MJRefresh; no title-based identity grouping.
Statistics count the complete requested range on the server. Unknown costs remain pending and currencies remain separate.
18 receipt confirmation is a local draft. Only final Save atomically writes the receipt, inventory and selected shopping fulfillment. Checking an item alone does not receive stock.
Source list and item revisions plus durable request UUID protect concurrent receipt and retry. Archived source stock can receive only historical returns, never new consumption.
implementationBoundary: Merchant QR item retrieval still requires an external provider.
Fixture, real database and live deployment checks are distinct.
